hero.title: About Chalak Champs
hero.subtitle: Bangladesh's #1 Skill-Based Kids Learning Platform - where every child becomes future-ready

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.english: Chalak Champs is a modern Skill-Based Learning Platform in Bangladesh, built to give children aged 3 to 15 real-life skills they need to thrive in tomorrow's world. We believe academic grades alone don't define a child's future. True growth comes from confidence, communication, creativity, and ability to solve real problems, and that's exactly what every course at Chalak Champs is designed to build.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.english: To make every child confident, skilled, and future-ready , through learning that is fun, practical, and effective.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.english: To become Bangladesh's most trusted Skill-Based Learning Platform , where every child is prepared for the future.

values.title: Our Values
values.english: We believe in building confidence, not just academic scores. We focus on practical skills that matter.

whatWeOffer.title: What We Offer
whatWeOffer.introEnglish: Every course at Chalak Champs is carefully designed to be simple, interactive, and practical , so children don't just learn, they apply.
whatWeOffer.tagsEnglish: Each course is tailored to child's age and learning pace , so growth feels natural, not forced.

cta.title: Start Your Child's Journey Today
cta.body: One free demo class is all it takes , see for yourself why thousands of parents across Bangladesh trust Chalak Champs.
